plugins.name: Wheel Plugin Manager
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Install, validate, repair, test, build and remove QAH wheel plugins without python.exe. Windows-safe: unpacks wheels directly and rejects malformed builds whose entry point could never be imported.

versions.changelog: Initial release: Windows-safe wheel installation without python.exe, wheel validation, fix/repair builds, cross-platform paths.
